newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Offer in India 0.25-pct diesel, MidEast plus $2.25.
newsitem.headline: Offer in India 0.25-pct diesel, MidEast plus $2.25.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) received a best offer of $2.55 a barrel above MidEast spot quotes for its tender to buy 0.25-percent sulphur diesel for November delivery, traders said on Friday.
India is seeking two 45,000-tonne cargoes of diesel for November 6-10 and November 16-20 deliveries on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Kandla on the Indian west coast.
The tender closes on Friday with offers valid for two days.
In its last tender, IOC bought one 45,000-tonne cargo of 0.25-percent sulphur diesel from Dutch trader Vitol at $2.50 premium to MidEast spot quotes for October 21-25 delivery, c-and-f Kandla.
